verdict.rationale: Slate's docs state directly that it automatically picks the right model for each job, for example planning with Claude, searching with GLM and executing with Codex, with Slate handling the routing. Per-slot default models can also be configured. missing for 10: documentation of how the selection logic works or its criteria, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the automatic routing works as claimed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the tool automatically pick the best model for each task

citations.quote: Slate automatically selects the right model for the job.
For example with slate you can plan/talk to claude and search with glm and execute with codex and slate handles it.
Set preferred default models for each slot with the `/models` dialog or `slate.json` under `models`.
